requirements.title: Canonical requirement registry
requirements.description: The Factory maintains a single canonical requirement registry with stable, never-reused identifiers and an explicit status lifecycle, so a new AI session can resume from repository state without rereading chat history.

requirements.title: Canonical invariant registry
requirements.description: The Factory maintains a canonical invariant registry that gives each immutable trust rule a stable identifier so it can be traced from requirements to tests and proofs.

requirements.title: Canonical policy registry
requirements.description: The Factory maintains a canonical policy registry recording active operational policies (model routing, Git automation safety, secrets, review lifecycle, scope discipline, evidence) with pointers to their source document and related invariants.

requirements.title: Architecture Decision Record log
requirements.description: The Factory maintains a canonical ADR log with stable identifiers, status and linkage to the requirements each decision affects.

requirements.title: Requirement/invariant traceability matrix
requirements.description: The Factory maintains a traceability matrix mapping each requirement to the invariants it protects and the deterministic checks that validate it, so requirement status claims are not unverifiable prose.

requirements.title: Canonical specification baseline versioning
requirements.description: The Factory records the current specification baseline version and its history so specification drift across phases is explicit and reviewable.

requirements.title: Implementation Reality Matrix
requirements.description: The Factory maintains an Implementation Reality Matrix distinguishing specification, implementation, test and evidence status per requirement, so a registry entry or folder is never treated as proof of implementation.
